newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended April 16 fell to $971.96 billion from $984.54 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 665 retail money market mutual funds fell $4.44 billion to $655.19 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds fell $2.27 billion to $536.05 billion, while assets of the 263 tax-exempt funds fell $2.17 billion to $119.14 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 323 institutional money market funds fell $8.15 billion to $316.77 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds decreased $5.21 billion to $285.42 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $2.93 billion to $31.36 billion, it said.
